ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT Greenland 27 LLC, having an office at 3050A Whitestone Expressway, A106, Flushing, NY11354 (Hereinafter the “Grantor"), and Hunter Square LLC, having an office at 3050A Whitestone Expressway, A106, Flushing, NY11354 (Hereinafter the “Developer"). RECITALS: WHEREAS, Grantor is the fee owner of certain land in the City of New York, County of Queens, State of New York, designated as Block 431 Lot 12(Base Lot), 1101 and 1102(subdivided condo tax lots, Condominium Plan No.1127) on the Tax Map of the City of New York (Hereinafter the “Tax Map"), and by the street address 42-43 27th Street, Long Island City, New York 11101, 42-43 27th Street, Units C1 and R1, Long Island City, New York 11101, and being more particularly described in Exhibit I annexed hereto (said premises being hereinafter called “Parcel A,”’ and any existing buildings and improvements located thereon q s  sn  s p  s,  o a hereinafter called "Premises A"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land located in the City of New York, County of Queens, State of New York, designated as Block 431 Lot 22 on the Tax Map, and by the street address 42-62 Hunter Street, Long Island City, New York 11101,and being more particularly described in Exhibit II annexed hereto (said parcel of land being hereinafter called "Parcel B" and any existing buildings and improvements located thereon being called the "Developer's Building"” and said land, buildings and improvements being hereinafter called "PremisesB"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new building (Hereinafter the “New Building") on Parcel B which will contain or use more zoning floor area and development rights than are now available under the Zoning Resolution if the Parcel B is an independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, the parties hereto desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as herein defined) for combining Parcel A and Parcel B into one single zoning lot for the purpose of transferring to Parcel B all of the Excess Development Rights associated with Parcel A to Parcel B in perpetuity; WHEREAS, the parties hereto executed a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (Hereinafter the “Declaration") in accordance with Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot (Hereinafter the “Combined Zoning Lot") comprised of Parcel A and Parcel B, which Declaration is dated as of December 18, 2020 and recorded on December 24,2020 under City Register File No.: (CRFN) 2020000367390 in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York;
